iran_nuclear.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
iran_nuclear.notes: Iran nuclear risk remains imminent: IAEA documentation says Iran still has not provided required access or status reports for facilities affected by attacks, and Reuters reported an Iranian lawmaker warning Tehran could move to higher-level enrichment if attacked.

iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR
iran_conventional.notes: Iran conventional risk remains imminent: Reuters continues to identify control of energy flow through the Strait of Hormuz as the next-clash trigger after recent US strikes and stalled peace efforts.

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
israel_lebanon.notes: Israel-Lebanon risk is critical but easing: Reuters reports a 45-day truce extension and follow-up Washington talks, while earlier Beirut and southern Lebanon strikes keep violation and force-posture risk live.

turkey.name: TURKEY
turkey.notes: Turkey remains deterrent: fresh search surfaced mediation warnings and commentary about avoiding the regional war, not a new cross-border surge or official atomic warning from Ankara.

india.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
india.notes: India-Pakistan remains deterrent: fresh search mostly returned stale 2025 crisis material and forecast commentary, not a new Kashmir crisis, border surge, or command alert.

russia.name: RUSSIA-NATO
russia.notes: Russia-NATO risk remains critical: Reuters reported Zelenskiy warning Russia is considering an operation from Belarus toward northern Ukraine or a NATO country; NATO criticism of Russian nuclear posture keeps strategic signaling elevated.

china.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
china.notes: China-Taiwan rises within elevated: Reuters noted Chinese activity testing integrated military capabilities under combat conditions and practicing precision strikes and island blockade drills; no direct clash reported.

north_korea.name: NORTH KOREA
north_korea.notes: North Korea remains deterrent/high-end watch: April short-range ballistic activity remains relevant background, but fresh search did not surface a current-window weapons event, device event, or official atomic escalation.

russia_ukraine.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
russia_ukraine.notes: Russia-Ukraine remains imminent: Reuters and Washington Post reporting describe pause breakdowns, energy-target strikes, a bloody week after a brief pause, and continued battlefield pressure despite diplomacy.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: Pakistan-Afghanistan remains elevated but falling: DW reports China-hosted talks made useful progress after February border fighting; residual force posture persists, but no fresh heavy clash surfaced in this scan.

sudan.name: SUDAN
sudan.notes: Sudan remains elevated/high-end: drone warfare, RSF/Sudan army deployments, external backing concerns and infrastructure pressure continue, but the fresh scan did not meet a new-tracker or imminent-spillover threshold.

israel_palestine.name: ISRAEL-PALESTINE
israel_palestine.notes: Israel-Palestine risk rising: Israel killed Hamas Gaza armed chief Izz al-Din al-Haddad and continued Gaza strikes while indirect talks over the post-war plan remain deadlocked; retaliatory risk increased though Hamas did not issue an explicit revenge threat.

latest_news.headline: Iran lawmaker warns on higher-level enrichment
latest_news.text: Reuters reported an Iranian lawmaker warning that Iran could move to higher-level enrichment if attacked, while IAEA access gaps persist.

latest_news.headline: Hormuz remains next Iran clash trigger
latest_news.text: Reuters commentary says renewed Tehran-Washington confrontation would become more likely as actors test who controls energy flow through the Strait of Hormuz.

latest_news.headline: Israel-Lebanon ceasefire extended 45 days
latest_news.text: Reuters reports Israel and Lebanon agreed to extend the truce after Washington talks, lowering near-term escalation pressure despite recent strikes.

latest_news.headline: Israel struck Beirut after ceasefire
latest_news.text: Reuters reported Israel struck Beirut for the first time since the truce, keeping violation risk active even as talks continue.

latest_news.headline: Zelenskiy warns of Russia-Belarus NATO option
latest_news.text: Reuters reported Zelenskiy saying Russia is considering an operation from Belarus either toward northern Ukraine or against a NATO country.

latest_news.headline: China drills practiced Taiwan blockade conditions
latest_news.text: Reuters noted Chinese drills tested integrated military capabilities under combat conditions, including precision strikes and blockading the island.

latest_news.headline: DPRK ballistic activity remains stale watch item
latest_news.text: Reuters and Al Jazeera reported April ballistic activity, but this scan found no fresh current-window weapons event or device event.

latest_news.headline: Ukraine hits Russian energy targets after pause ends
latest_news.text: Reuters reported Ukrainian attacks on Russian energy targets after the US-backed pause ended, while both sides traded accusations over the pause breakdown.

latest_news.headline: Bloody week follows brief Ukraine pause
latest_news.text: Washington Post reporting describes a bloody week after a brief pause, including lethal strikes and no clear end to the war.

latest_news.headline: Afghanistan-Pakistan talks called useful
latest_news.text: DW reports China-hosted Afghanistan-Pakistan talks made useful progress after February cross-border fighting, lowering near-term escalation pressure.
